insight: Founded in 2018 by the Crashlytics duo Jeff Seibert and Wayne Chang, whose prior startup Twitter bought.
name: Digits
tagline: AI-native general ledger for business owners and accountants.
description: Digits is an AI-native accounting platform that automates bookkeeping, month-end close, bill pay, invoicing, and real-time reporting. Custom-trained agents handle 24/7 transaction categorization, accrual schedules, and reconciliations, while "Ask Digits" answers finance questions in natural language. Built for business owners and accounting firms.
edge: AI-native general ledger with outcome-based pricing — firms pay only when 95%+ of transactions go zero-touch.
cons: Outcome pricing limited to accounting firms

references.title: Digits Announces Outcome-Based Pricing for Accounting Firms
